official_textual_definition: The competition metric is a variant of the Sharpe ratio, computed by dividing the mean Spearman rank correlation between the predictions and targets by the standard deviation.
official_submission_constraint: Submissions use the provided evaluation API to prevent looking forward in time.

problem_design_source.author: Tomoya Kitayama
problem_design_source.authority: The author states that he was responsible for the problem design of this Mitsui & Co. Kaggle competition and published the design details with Mitsui & Co.'s approval.
problem_design_source.cross_section: For each date t, compute Spearman rank correlation across target columns between predictions and actual targets.
problem_design_source.score_aggregation: Take mean(IC_t) divided by std(IC_t) across dates.

target_contract.ignored_target_authority: Kaggle Staff states that these targets remain in the prediction schema, require non-null predictions, and are ignored for scoring.

direct_execution_results.aggregation_axis: compute one correlation per target over holdout rows, then mean/std across target correlations

production_424_results.aggregation_axis: compute one correlation per target over holdout rows, then mean/std across target correlations

verified_contract.correlation_axis: cross-sectional across scored targets for each date
